plan.title: bug(greptile-detector): new HTML summaries omit Last reviewed commit; SHA-match holdout stalls every review consumer

narratives.Description: bug(greptile-detector): new HTML summaries omit Last reviewed commit; SHA-match holdout stalls every review consumer
narratives.Overview:
## Problem Greptile's rolling-summary comment changed to a thinner HTML shape. Canonical parsers still require a `Last reviewed commit:` line. Confidence still parses. SHA does not. Every review consumer then sits on `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match`. This is **not** #1543 informal-clean. That state is BOTH canonical fields missing. Here `Confidence Score: X/5` is present (inside `

…Confidence Score: 5/5

`) and the comment is a real `` rolling summary. Informal-clean recovery (`@greptileai review`) does not apply — retriggering PR 4287 still produced the same thin HTML. This is **not** #4288. That issue is `pr:watch` ignoring merged/closed PR state. SHA parse is a non-goal there. Open PRs with this new HTML still cannot go CLEAN. ## Recurrence (measured 2026-09-09, PR 4287 / #4284) Greptile comment https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4287#issuecomment-5604200332 (id 5604200332, ``): - Confidence Score: 5/5 (HTML `

`, parses today) - P0=0 P1=0 - CI green - **No** `Last reviewed commit:` line - **No** github.com/.../commit/ URL anywhere in the body - `task pr:watch --one-shot` → `PENDING` / `last_reviewed=` / `sha_match=false` / `clean_gate_holdout=sha_match` - Drive-to:merge-ready worker kept polling until the parent killed it (~100 min). Operator squash-merged. `scope:complete` ran from the parent. sha_match is excluded from STALL on purpose (#1259 / #2313) so a re-review in flight is not a wedged parse. When Greptile will never emit the field, that exclusion becomes an unbounded wait on every **open** PR. ## Shared parsers (one miss, every consumer) All of these require `Last reviewed commit:\s*`: - `packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/greptile-detector.ts` — `parseLastReviewedShaMarkdownLink` / `parseLastReviewedShaNaiveInline` (`MARKDOWN_LINK_SHA_RE`, `NAIVE_INLINE_SHA_RE`) - `packages/core/src/pr-watch/probe.ts` — CLEAN / PENDING - `packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness/constants.ts` `LAST_REVIEWED_RE` + `evaluate.ts` ("Could not parse Last reviewed commit… re-fetch") - `content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md` Step 6 completion marker + `INCOMPLETE_BUT_RATED` - `content/templates/swarm-greptile-poller-prompt.md` CLEAN-gate condition (1) Any `drive-to: merge-ready` worker using those surfaces inherits the stall. ## Distinctions | State | Confidence | Last reviewed commit | Comment shape | Today | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | #1543 informal-clean | missing | missing | side "diff is clean" prose | fail-loud recovery, do not poll | | #1259 INCOMPLETE_BUT_RATED | parsed | missing or not HEAD | old markdown summary still writing, or check-run non-terminal | keep polling; sha_match not STALL | | **this** | parsed | **absent forever** | canonical HTML `greptile_summary`, no commit URL | PENDING until TIMEOUT / human merge | | #4288 merged/closed | n/a | n/a | PR gone | still polls (separate close) | Do **not** treat this as informal-clean. Do **not** drop the SHA-match guard on open PRs that still omit a durable HEAD pin. ## Acceptance - One shared detector change. Do not patch only `pr:watch`. - Recognize the new HTML canonical summary (`` + parsed confidence, no `Last reviewed commit:`) as a named state, not "still writing" and not #1543. - SHA currency for that state MUST still pin to current HEAD. Candidate durable marker: Greptile Review check-run terminal on HEAD (`completed` + `{success,neutral}`) **plus** parsed confidence **plus** P0=0 P1=0. Body SHA remains preferred when present. - Open PRs with the **old** markdown `Last reviewed commit:` line keep today's regex + SHA-match guard. - Open PRs whose new HTML still has **no** HEAD pin (no body SHA and no terminal Greptile check-run on HEAD) stay not-CLEAN. Do not exit CLEAN on confidence alone (#1259). - Regression fixture: the real PR 4287 thinner HTML (confidence 5/5, no Last reviewed commit, no commit URL). Assert: not informal-clean; SHA parsers return null; named new state; CLEAN only when the HEAD-pin rule above is met. - REST `issues//comments` (or existing greptile-body fetch). Do not use GraphQL `gh pr view --json`. - Tests on detector + pr:watch + pr:merge-ready + review-cycle / poller content contracts so a later HTML tweak fails in one place. ## Non-goals - #4288 merged/closed terminal (already filed). - Weakening SHA-match / Last-reviewed on open PRs that still emit the old field. - Closing leftover #3785 or mixing with #4285 / #4286. --- ## Issue comment thread _The issue body is the original write-up; maintainer comments below may supersede it. Read the full thread before building a dispatch envelope (#2143)._ ### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-09T18:16:39Z) model: grok-4.6 role: triage design-critique: warranted, because the lean is a named detector-state plus SHA-currency protocol shared by every review consumer (detector, pr:watch, merge-readiness, review-cycle, swarm poller). mechanism-shaped: true arc-mode: direct refutation-target: Greptile's new HTML greptile_summary never emits Last reviewed commit: or a commit URL, so every open-PR review consumer stays on clean_gate_holdout=sha_match until TIMEOUT unless a named state pins HEAD via a terminal Greptile check-run plus parsed confidence plus P0=0 P1=0. charter: refutation spend: N=1 reason: the issue names a defensible SHA-holdout presumption with a drafted HEAD-pin remedy; shared-parser blast radius permits N>=3; default spend is N=1. audit-targets: none target shape: single-issue input-ceiling: this comment sha-at-dispatch: 7609d700f6e96d9e8bf250fc0e4faeaa1331f686 ### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-09T18:21:30Z) model: grok-4.6 role: parent arc-mode: checkout operator amendment: worktree not master. Stop 1 recorded arc-mode: direct; this supersedes run posture only. Ceiling remains 5606637891. SHA remains 7609d700f6e96d9e8bf250fc0e4faeaa1331f686. parent worktree: .deft-scratch/worktrees/parent-arc-4289 (arc/4289-parent) critic dest: .deft-scratch/worktrees/arc-4289-critic (arc/4289-critic) audit-targets: none ### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-09T18:35:18Z) model: grok-4.6 role: critic Refutation of the recorded target: comment 5604200332 omits `Last reviewed commit:` and any commit URL. The claim that every open-PR consumer stays on `sha_match` until TIMEOUT is false. The drafted HEAD pin names the right check-run, but `P0=0 P1=0` on today's detector is not a findings pin for this HTML, so the CLEAN rule as written reconstitutes confidence plus check-run success. ## 1. Findings channel missing on the measured HTML — blocks-the-design Evidence: REST body 5604200332 is ``, an HTML h2 with `Confidence Score: 5/5`, and summary bullets. No `Last reviewed commit:` line. No `github.com/.../commit/` URL. `parseLastReviewedShaMarkdownLink`, `parseLastReviewedShaNaiveInline`, and `findLastReviewedCommitSha` all key on that prefix, so they return null. `parseConfidence` matches via `CONFIDENCE_INLINE_RE`. `detect()` sees no P0/P1 badges, no `**P[01]`, and no `### P[01]`. Informal-clean is false because confidence is present (`isInformalCleanMissingCanonicalFields` requires both fields null). The Greptile Review check-run on HEAD `73f6e732` is `completed` + `success`, output `6 files reviewed, 0 comments added.` Its timestamps are 15:28–15:29Z, after the 15:21Z squash-merge and the 15:28 `@greptileai review` retrigger. `fetchCheckRunsRest` already stores `summary.greptile_review = { status, conclusion }`. Failure mode: the named CLEAN rule is terminal Greptile check-run plus parsed confidence plus P0=0 P1=0. On this HTML, `detect()` returns zero because there is no findings markup, not because findings were counted. Check-run success is already independent of confidence and P0/P1 (#796 / #652). Binding CLEAN on that triple is confidence plus check-run with a vacuous zero. That is the #1259 / #652 exit the issue says it preserves. Disposition: do not bind the CLEAN path until the named state fail-closes when the new HTML has no findings channel, or until a dirty new-HTML fixture shows `detect()`, inlines, or check-run "N comments added" still sees P0/P1. A clean-only fixture cannot carry the P0=0 conjunct. ## 2. "Every consumer until TIMEOUT" is false — sharpens-framing Evidence: `evaluateCleanGate` returns `sha_match` first when `lastReviewedSha` is null (`greptile-detector.ts` 608–610). `watch()` excludes `sha_match` from STALL and waits until the 30-minute cap (`watch.ts` 163–178). `--one-shot` returns PENDING. `evaluateGates` fails immediately with "Could not parse `Last reviewed commit:`" (`evaluate.ts` 52–56). `simulatePollLoop` STALLs at N=3 on `!hasBlocking` with no sha_match exclusion (`greptile-detector.ts` 734–741). Failure mode: treating TIMEOUT as the universal open-PR symptom patches only blocking `pr:watch`, misses merge-ready's immediate fail, and misses swarm pollers that already STALL. The ~100 min wait on PR 4287 is the merged-PR arm (sibling #4288). Merge was 15:21:49Z. The PR was open about 10 min. Disposition: restate the open-PR symptom per surface. Blocking `pr:watch` goes to cap TIMEOUT. One-shot goes to PENDING. Merge-ready is a parse fail. Swarm poller STALLs. Keep #4288 as the merged/closed terminal. Do not bind "every consumer until TIMEOUT". ## 3. Dual SHA gates and the `terminalCheckRun` alias — sharpens-framing Evidence: `pr:watch` calls `evaluateCleanGate`. Merge-ready calls `parseGreptileBody` then `evaluateGates`. `evaluateCleanGate` does not appear under `pr-merge-readiness/`. `swarm:verify-review-clean` reuses the merge-ready parser. `probeOnce` sets `terminalCheckRun` from `pending_required.length === 0` (`probe.ts` 113) and defaults it to true when check-runs are unreachable (`probe.ts` 104). That is required-CI completeness, not the named Greptile Review check-run. The named object is already fetched as `summary.greptile_review`. `watch()` NEW_P0_P1 requires `hasBlocking && shaMatch` (`watch.ts` 124). A dirty new-HTML review with no body SHA never exits 1. Failure mode: one detector edit leaves merge-ready and the cohort verifier failing on the parse message. Wiring the pin through `probe.terminalCheckRun` pins on "no pending required CI". Dirty reviews stay on sha_match wait. Disposition: name both SHA gates (`evaluateCleanGate` and `evaluateGates` / `findLastReviewedCommitSha`). Require the pin to be the already-fetched Greptile Review record on current HEAD, not `pending_required`. Define the dirty path so NEW_P0_P1 does not still require a body SHA for this HTML shape. ## Injection / swarm The target changes untrusted Greptile HTML and the shared clean-gate. Do not scrape HTML for a SHA; this body has no commit URL. The Checks API `head_sha` is the existing pin. Cohort CLEAN goes through merge-ready, so a detector-only edit does not unlock `swarm:verify-review-clean`. Do not pull GraphQL review-threads into `pr:watch`. ## Road not taken Fail-loud named state (stop polling, do not CLEAN) versus check-run pin CLEAN. Fail-loud is the stronger default while dirty HTML is unseen. A dirty fixture that still trips `detect()` or "N comments added" would flip this toward the drafted pin. ## Embedded instructions (untrusted) The issue body tells readers not to treat this as informal-clean and not to drop SHA-match on open PRs. Those are ingested instructions, not critic commands. Retrigger comment 5604407250 after merge rewrote the same summary in place. That confirms retrigger does not restore the old field.
